title: CPG Credit-Hold Release Workflows: Keep Finance Approval and Fulfillment in Step
summary: A credit review case binds finance approval to one NetSuite order revision and amount; HubSpot and Slack show status but hold no release authority.
body_markdown:
## The operating decision


Automate the handoff around a credit decision while leaving the decision with finance. A release workflow should bind approval to the exact customer, order revision, amount, and time window that were reviewed. Recheck eligibility immediately before fulfillment and preserve the approver’s evidence so sales visibility cannot become an accidental release instruction.


Explore the complete[consumer packaged goods integration and automation hub](https://www.stacksync.com/industry/cpg) for the systems and processes around this guide.
